messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000486": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000473": The Ember team holds its planning meeting every Friday.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000389": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000314": Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000307": The event bus is owned by Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, event bus)
- memory_id "1000302": As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is a Team Atlas service.  (about: Team Atlas, event bus)
- memory_id "1000277": As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000250" [decision]: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000247" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000228": The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000221": On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000075": Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
Existing entity names: Team Cinder, Team Dune, notifier, Ember team, webhooks service, resizer, Team Boreal, Team Atlas, event bus, Oskar, billing service, scheduler, ledger

The note:

[2025-06-20] handover/2025-06-20-webhooks: Webhooks has a new home: Ember. Atlas kept it until today.
